shownOnce: This secret is shown only once — copy it now.
genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Manage caller and administrator accounts.
users.createDesc: A temporary password will be generated and shown only once.
users.name: Name
users.deactivated: Account deactivated — their sessions are revoked
users.tempPasswordHint: Share this password with the user securely. It will never be shown again.
users.resetPasswordConfirmDesc: A new temporary password will be generated for {name} and their current sessions will be signed out.
users.deleteDesc: This action is permanent. Clients assigned to them will be unassigned (no client will be deleted). An account with history (calls, appointments, follow-ups or comments) cannot be deleted: deactivate it instead.

voip.title: Telephony (voip.ms)
voip.desc: SIP subaccount and outbound number (DID) used by the webphone.
voip.sipPasswordHint: Write-only: it is stored encrypted and never shown again. Leave blank to keep the current one.
voip.createSubaccountDesc: A strong SIP password will be generated, saved encrypted on the user and shown only once.
voip.sipPasswordSavedHint: Already saved (encrypted) on the user. Write it down if you are configuring another device.
voip.routeDid: Route this number to the subaccount
voip.ipHint: Tip: the voip.ms API requires the calling IP address to be allowed (Main menu → SOAP and REST/JSON API → Enable IP address).
voip.didConflict: This number is already assigned to {name} — it will be removed from their account when you save.
voip.subConflict: This SIP subaccount is already used by {name} — two people cannot share the same extension.

order.title: Order a new number
order.desc: The number is purchased from voip.ms, charged to the main account balance, then routed and assigned to {name}. Their SIP line is created automatically if needed.
order.perminuteHint: Lower monthly fee; every incoming minute is billed.
order.flatHint: Fixed monthly fee, incoming minutes included.
order.noNumbers: No numbers available here right now.
order.balance: voip.ms balance: {balance} $ — purchases are charged to this balance.
order.confirmHint: Number {number} ({price} $/mo) will be charged to the voip.ms balance immediately and assigned to {name}.

phone.readyHint: SIP account, password and number (DID) all set: this person can make and receive calls.
phone.no_didHint: SIP account ready, but no number (DID): they can call out but cannot receive calls. Assign them a number.
phone.not_configuredHint: No SIP credentials: their phone cannot register, so no call is possible.
phone.no_gatewayHint: The SIP-WSS gateway is not configured on the server: nobody can call until it is set.
phone.fixHint: Open the record to configure the line.

provision.title: Phone line
provision.slow: voip.ms is slow: this can take up to a minute.
provision.failed: Configuring the line failed — the account itself was created.
provision.noDid: No number (DID) is assigned automatically: pick one yourself.
provision.autoHint: Creates (or reuses) the voip.ms subaccount and stores the SIP password encrypted. Safe to repeat.

verify.title: Actual state at voip.ms
verify.ok: All good: this person can make and receive calls.
verify.partial: Outbound calls work, but some items still need fixing.
verify.unreachable: voip.ms did not answer. Try again in a moment.

reasons.gateway_missing: The SIP-WSS gateway is not configured on the server: nobody can call until it is set.
reasons.sip_missing: No SIP account stored. Use “Configure the line automatically”.
reasons.sub_not_found: The stored SIP account ({value}) does not exist at voip.ms. Reconfigure the line.
reasons.sub_ok: The subaccount does exist at voip.ms.
reasons.password_no_subaccount: Cannot check the password without a valid subaccount.
reasons.password_missing: No SIP password stored: the phone cannot register. Click “Resync”.
reasons.password_unknown: voip.ms did not return the password, so it cannot be compared. “Resync” will set a new one on both sides.
reasons.password_unreadable: The stored password cannot be decrypted (encryption key changed?). Click “Resync”.
reasons.password_mismatch: The stored password does not match the one at voip.ms: the phone cannot register. Click “Resync”.
reasons.password_ok: The stored password matches the one at voip.ms.
reasons.did_ok: A number ({value}) is assigned: inbound calls are possible.
reasons.did_missing: No number (DID): this person can call out but cannot receive. Assign them a free number.
reasons.routing_unavailable: voip.ms did not return the number list: routing not checked.
reasons.routing_did_unknown: This number does not exist at voip.ms — check the value stored on the record.
reasons.routing_none: This number has no routing at voip.ms.
reasons.routing_other: This number is routed to {value}, not to a SIP subaccount.
reasons.routing_ok: Inbound calls do reach this extension ({value}).
reasons.routing_main: Inbound calls go to the main account ({value}), not to this extension. Click “Route this number to the subaccount”.
reasons.routing_elsewhere: Inbound calls go to another extension ({value}). Click “Route this number to the subaccount”.

errors.email_taken: This email is already in use.
errors.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.cannot_demote_self: You cannot remove your own administrator role.
errors.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.has_activity: This user has history (calls, appointments, follow-ups or comments) that would be destroyed. Deactivate the account instead to keep the data.
errors.user_not_found: The target user no longer exists. Reload the page.

credentials.verifyEmail: Check the email address before sending these credentials: this exact address is the one to sign in with. A typo makes signing in impossible.

ownPassword.title: My password
ownPassword.desc: Change the password of your administrator account.
ownPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
ownPassword.tooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.

pipeline.subtitle: Pipeline categories and lead sources — colors, order and reassignment.

categories.desc: The stages of the calling pipeline. System categories are tied to the post-call buttons and cannot be deleted.

categories.formDesc: Name in French and English, plus a display color.
categories.deleteDesc: {count, plural, =0 {No client in this category.} one {# client is in this category — choose where it should go.} other {# clients are in this category — choose where they should go.}}

sources.title: Sources
sources.desc: Where leads come from (Facebook, referral, website…).
sources.name: Name
sources.deleteDesc: {count, plural, =0 {No client uses this source.} one {# client uses this source — choose where it should go.} other {# clients use this source — choose where they should go.}}
sources.nameTaken: A source with this name already exists.

pipeline.transferDesc: {count, plural, =0 {No client to move.} one {# client will move to the chosen destination. The original row is kept (empty).} other {# clients will move to the chosen destination. The original row is kept (empty).}}

pipeline.reassignRequired: Clients were attached in the meantime — counts refreshed, choose where they go.

importExport.title: Import / Export
importExport.subtitle: Import clients from a CSV file or export the database using filters.

import.title: Import clients (CSV)
import.desc: Upload a CSV file (Excel, Notion, etc.), map the columns, then run the import.
import.dropHint: Click to choose a file or drop it here.
import.parseError: Could not read this CSV file.
import.parsed: {count, plural, one {# row detected} other {# rows detected}} in {file}.
import.run: Import {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
import.invalidDefault: One of the default values (category, source or assignee) no longer exists. Reload the page, pick another one and run the import again.

issues.title: {count, plural, one {# row skipped — here's why} other {# rows skipped — here's why}}
issues.subtitle: Nothing is dropped silently. Each group explains the cause and what you can do.
issues.updated: {count, plural, =0 {No client updated} one {# client updated} other {# clients updated}}

duplicate_in_db.title: Already in the CRM (same phone)
duplicate_in_db.why: A client already exists with this number. You chose “Skip duplicates”, so these rows were not imported and the existing clients were left untouched.
duplicate_in_db.what: Update the existing clients with the file's data. If it's actually a different person, fix the number below and re-import. Doing nothing leaves them as they are.

duplicate_in_file.title: Duplicated inside the file
duplicate_in_file.why: This number appears more than once in your file. The first occurrence was imported and the rest skipped — no CRM data was lost.
duplicate_in_file.what: Nothing to do if the duplicates are identical. If they're two different people, fix the number below and re-import the row.

phone_invalid.title: Unreadable phone number
phone_invalid.why: The phone cell contains no digits at all (for example “n/a”, “tbd”, or free text). A number is required — without one the client can't be called.
phone_invalid.what: Type the correct number below, then re-import these rows. Without a valid number they stay out of the CRM.

phone_missing.title: Phone number missing
phone_missing.why: The phone column is empty on these rows — or the wrong column was mapped to the Phone field in step 2.
phone_missing.what: Check the column mapping in step 2 first. Otherwise type the number below and re-import these rows.

issues.fixed: {count, plural, =0 {No client created} one {# client imported} other {# clients imported}}
issues.editHint: Fix the number right here, then re-import those rows.

export.title: Export clients (CSV)
export.desc: Download a CSV file (UTF-8 with BOM, Excel-friendly) matching the selected filters.
export.note: The export includes every record matching the filters, with category, source and assignee names. Every export is recorded in the audit log.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Receive leads automatically from n8n, Facebook or your website.
webhooks.keyCount: {count, plural, =0 {No keys} one {# key} other {# keys}}

explain.title: Receive leads automatically
explain.desc: Connect n8n, Facebook Lead Ads or your website to create client records automatically.
explain.auth: Authentication: send the API key in the “x-api-key” header (or “Authorization: Bearer” followed by the key).
explain.nested: Fields can be at the root of the JSON or inside a “data” object (n8n format). Accented Facebook form field names are accepted as-is.
explain.n8nExample: Sample JSON body for n8n (HTTP Request node)
explain.n8nHint: In n8n, enable “JSON Body” and paste this example: the double-brace expressions will be replaced with the Facebook lead data.

keys.title: API keys
keys.desc: Each integration should have its own key, with its default values (category, source, assignee).
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create one to connect n8n.
keys.createDesc: Use a meaningful name (e.g. “n8n — Facebook Buyer”). The key will be shown only once.
keys.createdDesc: Copy this key now and paste it into the x-api-key header of your integration.
keys.name: Key name
keys.deleteDesc: Integrations using this key will stop working immediately.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Google Calendar, booking hours, telephony provider and SMS consents.

google.title: Google Calendar
google.desc: Appointments booked by callers are created in this calendar (with a Google Meet link).
google.notConnected: No Google account connected. Connect the broker's account to enable appointment booking with Google Meet.

booking.title: Booking
booking.desc: Time slots offered to callers when booking appointments.
booking.minNoticeHint: No appointment can be offered or booked closer than this delay — on screen and by the SMS assistant alike. E.g. 180 = nothing with less than 3 h notice.
booking.locationPlaceholder: E.g.: Québec City office, 123 Laurier Blvd
booking.brokerEmailHint: Receives the Google invitation for every appointment. If it is also the connected Google account, the event simply appears on that calendar (Google never e-mails the organizer). Leave empty to invite only the client.
booking.brokerEmailInvalid: Invalid e-mail address — enter a full address or leave the field empty.

sms.title: SMS and consents
sms.desc: Consent rules applied to text messages sent by the CRM.
sms.hint: This period is stamped on NEW consents recorded in the ledger — existing entries keep their expiry. Six months is the CASL / Law 25 implied-consent window after an inquiry; reserve longer periods for express consent.
sms.applyExisting: Also apply to consents already on record
sms.applyExistingHint: Recomputes the expiry of every non-revoked SMS consent from its grant date. Revoked consents are never touched.
sms.confirmBody: {updated, plural, one {# consent will be updated.} other {# consents will be updated.}}
sms.confirmRevived: Caution: {revived, plural, one {# expired consent will become valid again} other {# expired consents will become valid again}} — make sure the chosen period reflects consent that was actually obtained.
sms.confirmLapsed: {lapsed, plural, one {# currently valid consent will become expired} other {# currently valid consents will become expired}} — no more texts can be sent to those clients.
sms.backfillDone: {updated, plural, one {# consent updated.} other {# consents updated.}}

telephony.title: Telephony
telephony.desc: Provider used by the callers' webphone.
telephony.testOk: Connection successful — {count, plural, =0 {no subaccounts} one {# subaccount} other {# subaccounts}}.
telephony.testFail: Failed to reach the voip.ms API
telephony.ipHint: The voip.ms API requires the server IP address to be allowed (Main menu → SOAP and REST/JSON API).
telephony.twilioEnvNote: Twilio environment variables present (values are never displayed):

transcripts.title: AI call notes
transcripts.desc: Every recorded call is listened to by a model, summarized, and the note is pushed as a comment on the client's record.
transcripts.enabledDesc: Processes recordings attached by the voip.ms sync (catch-up: last 72 hours). Every processed call is billed to the OpenRouter account — the cost shows on the Consumption page.
transcripts.detailExhaustive: Exhaustive — everything recorded, timestamped, even the incidental
transcripts.modelHint: Only models that accept audio input are listed. The free-text field lets you enter an id missing from the catalog.
transcripts.modelsLoadError: Could not load the model catalog
transcripts.minSecondsHint: Below this threshold there is nothing to summarize (voicemail, wrong number): the call is skipped at no cost.
transcripts.maxMinutesHint: Beyond this, the audio is too heavy for a single request: the call is skipped.
transcripts.keepTranscriptHint: Stores the full transcript in the database in addition to the note (more billed output tokens).
transcripts.envNote: OPENROUTER_API_KEY is missing: no notes will be produced until the key is configured.

killSwitch.title: Kill switch
killSwitch.desc: Stops EVERY SMS send, whatever the mode, until lifted by hand.
killSwitch.up: Kill switch up — sends are allowed
killSwitch.lowered: Kill switch lowered: {cancelled} queued send(s) cancelled
killSwitch.confirmLowerBody: Every queued send is cancelled and nothing leaves — campaigns, assistants, hand-typed messages — until it is lifted.

numbers.title: SMS numbers
numbers.desc: The lines that send and receive texts: label, daily cap, active or not, default assistant.
numbers.empty: No number registered. Add the one Twilio assigned you, or sync from the Messaging Service.
numbers.label: Label
numbers.defaultAssistantHint: Takes an inbound thread that has no assistant (someone writes to the number outside a campaign). Empty = a human replies.
numbers.syncUnconfigured: Twilio is not configured (account, API key, Messaging Service).
numbers.inUse: This number has threads: deactivate it instead of deleting it.
numbers.invalidPhone: Invalid number — North American format expected.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: {count, plural, =0 {No entries} one {# entry} other {# entries}} — sensitive actions are recorded here.
audit.noChanges: No field-level changes were recorded for this entry.

billing.title: Usage and spending
billing.subtitle: What each caller uses and what voip.ms charges, period by period.
billing.balanceLow: Low balance — ordering a number could fail.
billing.costUnavailable: voip.ms priced none of these calls.
billing.rangeTooLong: Range too long — {days} days maximum (the voip.ms call log gets too slow beyond that).
billing.unattributedHint: Main account or deleted line — included in the total.
billing.cancelDesc: Number {number} ({name}) stops being billed and will be LOST: voip.ms puts it back on sale and it cannot be recovered. Incoming calls to it will no longer arrive.
billing.costSource: Amounts derived from the voip.ms call log (a call split across legs is counted once). The official voip.ms statement prevails.
billing.confirmLabel: To confirm, type the number's last 4 digits ({digits})
billing.didNotOwned: This number is no longer on the voip.ms account — the list was stale.
billing.confirmMismatch: The digits you typed do not match the number.
billing.recurringNote: Monthly number rental is not shown here: only the period's calls are priced.
billing.grandTotalNote: voip.ms telephony (real) + Twilio SMS (real if available, otherwise estimated) + AI assistants (real) + AI call notes (real).
billing.smsRateNote: FALLBACK rate: used only when Twilio’s real cost is unavailable. Default: Twilio’s published outbound SMS rate (US/Canada).
billing.aiEmpty: No assistant turns in this period.
billing.totalPartial: Partial total: one source is still loading or unavailable.
billing.aiAccountNote: Provider figure (API /credits). Turns before Aug 26, 2026 under-counted: only the last call was summed, without classifier or judges.
billing.transcriptEmpty: No call notes over the period.
billing.transcriptIssues: {failed} failed · {skipped} skipped (too short, no client record…) over the period.

classification.title: Automatic classification
classification.subtitle: What the assistant may conclude from a sentence, and where it then files the record.
classification.empty: No rule: the assistant files nothing.
classification.noCategories: No pipeline category exists yet — create some under Pipeline before writing a rule.
classification.whenPlaceholder: the project is more than six months away
classification.toolHint: These rules only apply to assistants whose "File the record" tool is ticked in the Tools tab. The list is also the allow-list: a category absent from here cannot be set by the assistant.
